nodes.label: stellar-sdk<11.0.0,>=10.0.0
nodes.rationale: django-polaris 2.5.0's own metadata constrains stellar-sdk to <11.0.0,>=10.0.0; a version outside that range (e.g. 12.3.0, previously pinned to dodge a since-removed-symbol ImportError against 2.6.0) makes pip's resolver fail outright, so the pin stays inside polaris's declared range instead of overriding it.

nodes.label: passive-monitor Service
nodes.rationale: READ-ONLY against mainnet by design; must not contain any write call such as Horizon.submitTransaction.

nodes.label: Event Query Window Workaround
nodes.rationale: The public soroban-testnet RPC silently returns zero events for a startLedger more than ~9,000-12,000 ledgers behind tip despite its own validation accepting a much longer range, so the code intentionally queries a shorter, empirically-safe window (MAX_QUERYABLE_LEDGERS_BACK) instead of the advertised maximum, with a catch-and-retry as a secondary safety net.

nodes.label: Demo Data Fallback
nodes.rationale: If the live Soroban RPC read fails entirely, the dashboard automatically falls back to deterministic demo data in lib/mock-data.ts and shows a banner, so the UI is always reviewable even before contracts are deployed.

nodes.label: Premium Web3 Visual Direction
nodes.rationale: Dark-first 'premium web3' interface: glass-panel cards, SVG ring gauge score, Phosphor icons, framer-motion animation; light and dark palettes designed together with contrast checked separately for each.

nodes.label: Cross-Contract Authorization
nodes.rationale: PerformanceOracle is the only caller AnchorRegistry accepts for update_score/slash, enforced by Soroban's own invoker authentication rather than a shared secret or allowlist.

nodes.label: Mainnet Read-Only Design
nodes.rationale: passive-monitor never signs or submits a mainnet transaction; it only scans Horizon payment history for listed anchors, keeping mainnet strictly observational.

nodes.label: Proportional Slashing Design
nodes.rationale: Slashing is a fixed percentage of current (not original) stake, so repeated failures compound as shrinking slices rather than wiping the anchor out in one step.

nodes.label: Weighted EMA Scoring
nodes.rationale: Per-source-weighted exponential moving average: RealMainnet and RealTestnet move the score faster than SimulatedMock.

nodes.label: Score Math (Weighted EMA) Rationale
nodes.rationale: Weighted EMA lets real signals (RealMainnet/RealTestnet) move the score faster than SimulatedMock; a single slow-but-successful transaction still scores far better than a failure.
